document.abstract: This amendment has been created to address a mistake in the 2013 publication of ST 2067-5. A mistaken value is present in the table in Section 5.3. As defined in item 13, Section 5.1.1, the primary package of the file shall be the top-level File Package. The table entry mistakenly calls out “material package”.
